headline: Powerboat world championship roars into Key West
dateline: Nov 1–8 · races Wed Nov 4, Fri Nov 6, Sun Nov 8 from 10am
what: Race World Offshore's Key West World Championship runs on a harbor course you can watch from shore. Race boats parade down Duval Street Sun Nov 1 around 4pm; the dry pits at Truman Waterfront are free all week.
why: A great show if you're in Key West – but the race course is off-limits on race days, so plan harbor moves around them.
todo: Move your boat on non-race days and listen on VHF 16 for Coast Guard broadcasts. Free viewing at Mallory Square.
